commits.subject: Extract TUI thread resume finalization (#62171)
commits.reason: Use the upstream finalizer for resume requests that produce a fresh StartedThread. Keep the original request and finalization inside the same ALab construction scope.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 fc0b0fdb65d26f9d38f152effd4739f6318edca3241cf935385428b8da99ec80.

The caller still retries unsupported pagination before finalizing. The extracted method carries the typed response, configuration, thread ID and hydration scope through subscription, history hydration, parent title and task-tool setup. In the fork the outer construction scope ends after this entire sequence. A retained original UI object has a separate reconciliation path.
commits.revisit: Exercise real resume with saved settings, migration and lock contention, alongside existing-session model promotion and retained-original reconciliation.

commits.subject: Remove Python from MCP permission request hook tests (#62172)
commits.reason: Use the native Core test executable for the MCP permission hook fixture so the permission checks run without a separate Python runtime.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 84154b779e9c259a5e480369526787ee7113a81ec6a0209a27ccd35842ebf043.

Only the Core test module and Bazel test inputs change. The explicit fixture argument selects a child process that reads the real hook payload, appends and flushes its JSON log, then flushes the configured JSON response. Other invocations run the normal test executable.
commits.revisit: Run the permission hook cases covering allow, tool-name fallback and remembered approval under the protected test runner.
